_doc: Trace It — what the Words, Names and Places tabs offer out of the box. Read by build.py (→ data.json) and make-voice.py (→ voice/). words: the Sound Book lessons of these stages (tools/soundbook.json), in lesson order; 'emoji' adds pictures to the Word Builder table for lesson words it lacks (only where a picture really fits). names / places: GENERIC starters only. PRIVACY: this bundle is also the public demo page — a real family name, town or street must never be written here; those are added on the tablet (the ➕ tile) and live in the tablet's store (/api/store/trace/custom.json).
